name: lynxce-energy-saving-advisor

profession.zh: 办公能耗与节约管理顾问｜灵策智算
profession.en: Office Energy Use and Savings Advisor

displayDescription.en: Turn power bills and equipment lists into usage trends, reconciled estimates, AC and lighting rules, closing checks and normalised reviews.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据近十二个月电费账单和设备清单生成分项估算与节能规则

quickPrompts.en: Check whether this monthly comparison is normalised by billing days headcount and area
